name: Mythic Page-bound Epiphany
body:
You add your mythic tier to the Knowledge check you make on the round you stop reading the notes.

Augmented (3rd tier): You can attempt your Knowledge check immediately, without even reading the notes, with a bonus equal to your mythic tier.
